method.problem: F_0(x) on [a, a+W], t = 2(x-a)/W - 1, p(t)/(1+q1 t+...+qk t^k), stored count (m+1)+k, k <= 12
method.second_edge: a2 = 2*x0; every Group A width doubled, so the cross-ratio and W/a are matched
method.acceptance: binary64 coefficients, exact barycentric-to-monomial conversion at 70 digits, Horner by both the fused and separate routes, worst error; denominator guard min|den| >= 1e-3 max|den|; 2001-node certify grid, 4001-node check; reference F_0 at 70 digits
method.count: smallest stored count with an exhibited admissible fit (upper bound, not a minimality proof)
method.slopes: OLS of log2 N on log2 W, thirteen dyadic widths, standard error sqrt(SSR/(n-2)/SXX)
method.paired_z: slope difference with the covariance of the two edges' residuals at the same widths; se_paired^2 = se1^2 + se2^2 - 2 cov / SXX
method.L: L = log(F_0(a)/eps) for the absolute target, natural log, as the paper's second-edge record does; L = log(1/eps) for the relative targets
